utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'West Hollywood' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - 100% Green Power (default)
value.notes: Confirmed via a directly-fetched California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) press release: West Hollywood is explicitly named among the communities on 100% Green Power as their default CPA energy option. Customers may choose another CPA option or opt out at any time.

county.notes: West Hollywood is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of West Hollywood Building and Safety Division
permit_authority.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated fetch was intermittent, not a persistent block).

permit_url.notes: Corrected this session: the previously-cited URL 404s (the page moved under a new 'Building and Safety Plan Check Services' subsection). Directly re-verified via browser.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes West Hollywood/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: The City's own page references guides/checklists for each system type (PV, SWH, SPH) but links them as generic 'Learn More' buttons whose destination could not be resolved to a specific itemized document list this session.

value: Schedule inspections through the Building and Safety Division's automated inspection request line at (323) 848-6335
Requests received within business hours (8:00am-6:00pm) are typically scheduled for the next business day
inspection_steps.notes: Per the City's own 'Solar West Hollywood' page, Inspections section.

value.program_or_pathway: Streamlined/expedited permitting for qualifying small residential rooftop solar systems (implementing AB 2188)
other_conditions: Covers Simple Photovoltaic (PV) systems 10kW or less, Solar Water Heating (SWH) systems 30kW thermal or less, and Solar Pool Heating (SPH) systems 30kW thermal or less on single- or duplex-family dwellings
Processed similar to a nondiscretionary Zone Clearance permit; systems exceeding zoning height limits or adversely impacting public health/safety do not qualify
LA County Fire Department review/approval for these installations is deferred to the City's Building and Safety Division
SCE interconnection approval is separate from the City's approval and may take up to 30 days

value.name: Building, electrical, and plumbing plan check and permit fees for qualifying residential rooftop solar
value.notes: The City's own page states these fees 'have been waived by the City of West Hollywood' for qualifying systems. A Planning Division zone clearance fee, any required structural-upgrade permit fees, and any State/outside-agency fees still apply and are not waived.
